dealers.title: Shipping auction vehicles for your dealership?
dealers.body: Y7 dispatches Copart, IAA, and Manheim loads for licensed dealers every day — weekly invoicing, dedicated dispatcher, and volume tiers from the sixth load of the month.

exporters.title: Getting this car to a port?
exporters.body: If the end game is ocean freight, we run auction-to-port logistics end-to-end — gate passes, warehouse drops, carrier management across Newark, Houston, Savannah, Baltimore, LA, and Jacksonville.

shipMyCar.title: Shipping one vehicle door-to-door?
shipMyCar.body: Y7 books door-to-door carrier space across all 50 states, usually with a firm quote back inside an hour. Open or enclosed, running or inop — one form, one dispatcher.
